newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates remain steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates remain steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates remained steady on Monday on demand from mill owners and are likely to hover around the same level amid fears that rains may slow down the arrival of fresh supplies, dealers said.

"The weather condition will decide the prices in the coming days," dealer Kishan Chand said. "If there are rains, they will hit the arrival of fresh supplies. But once monsoon season is over, the cotton rates will fall."
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted around 2,200 ($54.16) rupees per maund (37.32 kg).
